        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Fetch Empirical Metallicity Data from NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP API\n",
        "# We query the 'ps' (Planetary Systems) table for Kepler-10 stellar properties\n",
        "nasa_tap_url = \"https://caltech.edu\"\n",
        "query = \"select top 1 hostname, st_mass, st_met from ps where hostname = 'Kepler-10'\"\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Streaming empirical baseline metrics from NASA Open Source Archives...\")\n",
        "try:\n",
        "    response = requests.get(nasa_tap_url, params={'query': query, 'format': 'json'}, timeout=15)\n",
        "    if response.status_code == 200 and response.json():\n",
        "        nasa_data = response.json()[0]\n",
        "        # Kepler-10 empirical metallicity [Fe/H] is ~ -0.15 dex\n",
        "        fe_h_dex = float(nasa_data.get('st_met', -0.15))\n",
        "        print(f\"Successfully loaded data from NASA for {nasa_data['hostname']}!\")\n",
        "        print(f\"NASA Recorded Host Star Metallicity [Fe/H]: {fe_h_dex} dex\")\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        print(\"NASA API response empty. Defaulting to standard baseline.\")\n",
        "        fe_h_dex = -0.15\n",
        "except Exception as e:\n",
        "    print(f\"API Connection timed out. Applying standard stellar metallicity baseline. Details: {e}\")\n",
        "    fe_h_dex = -0.15\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert dex metallicity back to linear iron mass fraction relative to solar baseline (~0.0014)\n",
        "initial_fe = 0.0014 * (10**fe_h_dex)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Simulation Parameters Setup\n",
        "time_steps = 1000\n",
        "t = np.linspace(0, 100, time_steps)  # Normalized Lifetime percentage (0% to 100%)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Abundance arrays initialize\n",
        "X_H  = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "X_He = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "X_C  = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "X_O  = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "X_Si = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "X_Fe = np.zeros(time_steps)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Dynamic Initial Abundances adjusted with NASA-derived iron scaling\n",
        "X_H  = 0.74\n",
        "X_He = 0.24\n",
        "X_C  = 0.01 - (initial_fe * 0.1)\n",
        "X_O  = 0.009 - (initial_fe * 0.1)\n",
        "X_Si = 0.0009\n",
        "X_Fe = initial_fe\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Kinetic Nucleosynthesis Network Simulator Loop\n",
        "for i in range(1, time_steps):\n",
        "    age = t[i]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Carry forward historical fractions\n",
        "    X_H[i]  = X_H[i-1]\n",
        "    X_He[i] = X_He[i-1]\n",
        "    X_C[i]  = X_C[i-1]\n",
        "    X_O[i]  = X_O[i-1]\n",
        "    X_Si[i] = X_Si[i-1]\n",
        "    X_Fe[i] = X_Fe[i-1]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stage 1: Main Sequence - Hydrogen Burning (0% to 75% of life)\n",
        "    if age <= 75:\n",
        "        rate = 0.009 * (X_H[i-1]**2)\n",
        "        X_H[i]  -= rate\n",
        "        X_He[i] += rate\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stage 2: Red Giant / Supergiant - Helium Burning (75% to 90% of life)\n",
        "    elif 75 < age <= 90:\n",
        "        rate_3a = 0.05 * (X_He[i-1]**3)  # Triple-Alpha rate approximation\n",
        "        if X_He[i] > 0.02:\n",
        "            X_He[i] -= rate_3a\n",
        "            X_C[i]  += rate_3a * 0.7\n",
        "            X_O[i]  += rate_3a * 0.3\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stage 3: Advanced Burning - Carbon/Oxygen to Silicon (90% to 98% of life)\n",
        "    elif 90 < age <= 98:\n",
        "        rate_adv = 0.08 * X_C[i-1]\n",
        "        if X_C[i] > 0.001:\n",
        "            X_C[i]  -= rate_adv\n",
        "            X_O[i]  += rate_adv * 0.2\n",
        "            X_Si[i] += rate_adv * 0.8\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stage 4: Silicon Burning to Iron Peak (98% to 100% of life)\n",
        "    elif age > 98:\n",
        "        rate_si = 0.25 * X_Si[i-1]\n",
        "        if X_Si[i] > 0.00001:\n",
        "            X_Si[i] -= rate_si\n",
        "            X_Fe[i] += rate_si\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Data Visualization Plotting\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_H, label='Hydrogen ($^1$H)', color='royalblue', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_He, label='Helium ($^4$He)', color='darkcyan', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_C, label='Carbon ($^{12}$C)', color='forestgreen', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_O, label='Oxygen ($^{16}$O)', color='purple', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_Si, label='Silicon ($^{28}$Si)', color='darkorange', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_Fe, label='Iron Peak ($^{56}$Fe)', color='crimson', linewidth=2.2)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.yscale('log')\n",
        "plt.ylim(1e-5, 1.5)\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Normalized Stellar Lifetime (%)', fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Mass Fraction (Log Scale)', fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.title('Stellar Nucleosynthesis Simulation using NASA Empirical Metal Baselines', fontsize=13)\n",
        "plt.grid(True, which=\"both\", ls=\"--\", alpha=0.5)\n",
        "plt.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=10)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Layout annotations for nucleosynthesis zones\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=75, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(35, 2e-4, 'H-Burning\\n(p-p/CNO)', horizontalalignment='center', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=90, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(82.5, 2e-4, 'He-Burning\\n(3-$\\\\alpha$)', horizontalalignment='center', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=98, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(94, 2e-4, 'C/O/Ne', horizontalalignment='center', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(99.2, 2e-4, 'Si->Fe', horizontalalignment='center', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

        "        if X_C[i] > 0.001:\n",
        "            X_C[i]  -= rate_adv\n",
        "            X_O[i]  += rate_adv * 0.2\n",
        "            X_Si[i] += rate_adv * 0.8\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stage 4: Silicon Burning to Iron Peak (98% to 100% of life)\n",
        "    elif age > 98:\n",
        "        rate_si = 0.25 * X_Si[i-1]\n",
        "        if X_Si[i] > 0.00001:\n",
        "            X_Si[i] -= rate_si\n",
        "            X_Fe[i] += rate_si\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Data Visualization Plotting\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_H, label='Hydrogen ($^1$H)', color='royalblue', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_He, label='Helium ($^4$He)', color='darkcyan', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_C, label='Carbon ($^{12}$C)', color='forestgreen', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_O, label='Oxygen ($^{16}$O)', color='purple', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_Si, label='Silicon ($^{28}$Si)', color='darkorange', linewidth=1.8)\n",
        "plt.plot(t, X_Fe, label='Iron Peak ($^{56}$Fe)', color='crimson', linewidth=2.2)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.yscale('log')\n",
        "plt.ylim(1e-5, 1.5)\n",
        "plt.xlim(0, 100)\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Normalized Stellar Lifetime (%)', fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Mass Fraction (Log Scale)', fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.title('Stellar Nucleosynthesis Simulation using NASA Empirical Metal Baselines', fontsize=13)\n",
        "plt.grid(True, which=\"both\", ls=\"--\", alpha=0.4, zorder=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=10)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Layout adjustments: Elevated label placement and added clean white backdrops (bbox)\n",
        "label_height = 1e-2  # Raised from 2e-4 to prevent overlap with bottom trace lines\n",
        "bbox_props = dict(boxstyle=\"round,pad=0.3\", fc=\"white\", ec=\"gray\", lw=0.5, alpha=0.85)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=75, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(37.5, label_height, 'H-Burning\\n(p-p/CNO)', horizontalalignment='center', fontsize=9, bbox=bbox_props)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=90, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(82.5, label_height, 'He-Burning\\n(3-$\\\\alpha$)', horizontalalignment='center', fontsize=9, bbox=bbox_props)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=98, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)\n",
        "plt.text(94, label_height, 'C/O/Ne', horizontalalignment='center', fontsize=8, bbox=bbox_props)\n",
        "plt.text(99.0, label_height * 0.1, 'Si->Fe', horizontalalignment='center', fontsize=8, color='crimson', weight='bold')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
